evidence.ACL: Flattening of ACL slope and increased singal intensity, C/W ACL tear.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of medial femoral condyle and medial and lateral tibial plateau, in favor of chondromalacia.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of medial femoral condyle and medial and lateral tibial plateau, in favor of chondromalacia.
evidence.PF OA: Mild fraying surface of articular cartilage of patella.
evidence.Contusion: Hyperintensity foci of tibial intercondylar eminence on F/S T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
